value.name: HBO promo airs about Lowell documentary
value.description: A TV plays a promo for the upcoming documentary about Lowell and crack street, framing the city and the Ward brothers negatively.
evidence: CRACK STREET' PLAYS ON A TV LOWELL MAN ON THE STREET DOCUMENTARY INTERVIEWS.
REAL INTERVIEWS WITH REAL LOWELL. TALKING ABOUT "HIGH ON CRACK STREET" AIRING THAT NIGHT... HEARD IT MAKES THE CITY LOOK BAD...MICKY & DICKY BAD FOR THE CITY... DREAM IS DEAD...

value.name: Micky enters Dunkin' Donuts
value.description: Micky arrives at a crowded Dunkin' Donuts looking worn down and out of shape, with his healed hand still bothering him.
evidence: DUNKIN' DONUTS - CHELMSFORD ST., LOWELL - DAY Raining. Micky runs into a crowded Dunkin' Donuts, tired, dark circles, out-of-shape.
HAND HEALED, HABITUALLY STRETCHING AND CLENCHING IT.

value.name: Customers stare at Micky
value.description: The people in the shop notice Micky and whisper about him as he comes in.
evidence: Everybody looking at him, some whisper.

value.name: Micky greets Mickey O'Keefe
value.description: Micky spots Mickey O'Keefe in the back of the shop and calls out to him.
evidence: Micky's eyes wide, catches sight of Mickey O'Keefe in the back drinking coffee, reading the newspaper, still in his police uniform.

value.name: Mickey O'Keefe greets and checks Micky's hand
value.description: Mickey O'Keefe stands, hugs Micky, and asks how his hand is healing.
evidence: MICKEY O'KEEFE (stands, hugs Micky hello) How's ya hand?!

value.name: Mickey invites Micky to the gym
value.description: Mickey O'Keefe jokingly invites Micky to come down to the gym.
evidence: Why don't ya come down to the gym if ya want? Ya fat fuck, look atcha.

value.name: Micky worries about HBO documentary
value.description: Micky complains that the upcoming HBO movie will make people think he did something wrong and that everyone is staring at him because of it.
evidence: Now I gotta worry about this movie tonight on HBO, everybody lookin' at me like I did somethin' wrong, ain't my fault he's on TV.

value.name: Mickey O'Keefe advises Micky not to watch
value.description: Mickey O'Keefe tells Micky it is better for him not to see the documentary because it will only make him feel bad.
evidence: It's bettah for ya if ya don't see it, Micky, it's just gonna make ya feel bad.

value.name: Mickey defends Micky to the crowd
value.description: Mickey O'Keefe turns on the onlookers and tells them Micky is not the one on TV, but his brother is.
evidence: [turns to everyone] What are you lookin' at? He ain't gonna be on TV, it's his crazy brothah.
